textPairs: 这段历史为何与承销相关

The RCM is not a static subsidy. It has been re-pointed three times — once because the market was over-built, once because renewables changed what capacity has to do, and once because the cheapest new entrant stopped being a gas turbine and became a battery. Each re-pointing changed which projects earned full value, without changing any physical asset.
RCM并非静态补贴。它已被三次重新定向 — 一次因市场超建，一次因新能源改变了容量的职能，一次因最低成本新进入者由燃气轮机变为电池。每次重新定向都改变了哪些项目能获得足额价值，而任何实体资产本身并未改变。
